pages.text:
## Early Voting is April 10th – 17th!
“I have been fighting for our communities and working with others to get things done. No other candidate can say that. I’m a trailblazer who has been and will continue to be a voice for the people.”
– Troy Carter
*If you’ve saved your information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately.
## Change is possible.
Let’s do the work together.
## In Congress Troy Will:
- Fight without ceasing for Louisianians to be able to live the “American Dream” by creating equal and fair housing legislation.
- Continue the fight for our citizens who are living with disabilities.
- Fight for criminal justice reform, environmental justice, equal pay and a living wage for all Louisianians.
- Advocate for the reduction or elimination of student loan debt.
- Champion for government to allow women to make 100% of the decisions concerning their health and reproductive rights.
- Ensure COVID-19 recovery funding reaches everyone and that our community is not left behind while supporting small business, creating job training programs, and individuals who are suffering financially because of the pandemic.
- Expand access to quality and affordable healthcare while guaranteeing all Louisiana residents have access to the COVID-19 vaccine.
On the Issues Troy’s COVID Relief Plan
## Troy is Listening
I am Listening. This congressional seat is for the people and powered by people. As Congressman I’ll be your voice in Washington representing the needs of the people in Louisiana. I’m listening. I need to hear from you. Let’s work together for the change that is long overdue.

KYC (Know Your Customer) is standard across licensed casinos. It confirms your identity, age, and source of funds to prevent money laundering. Expect to provide a photo ID (passport or driver’s licence), a recent proof of address (utility bill or bank statement), and sometimes a payment-method screenshot or selfie match.
Does it affect payout speed? Yes—if you delay verification, your withdrawal sits pending. The fastest route is to complete KYC right after registration. Once verified, most subsequent withdrawals sail through, and only large or unusual requests may trigger additional checks. Keep documents current and legible; mismatched names or expired IDs cause avoidable delays.

Upload documents only through the secure cashier or document portal, never by email or chat attachments. Provide clear scans of your ID and proof of address. Once verified, future withdrawals move faster and further document requests are rare.
## What is a pending period and how does it impact withdrawals?
The pending period is the time between submitting your request and the casino approving it. During this stage, the site confirms wagering, checks limits, and performs KYC if needed. Short pending periods are crucial; once your request flips to “paid,” the payment method’s own settlement time begins (often minutes for wallets and crypto).

E-wallets like Skrill, Neteller, Payz, and PayPal are popular for their speed and separation from day-to-day banking. Crypto appeals to players who want rapid settlement and higher limits, provided they’re comfortable managing wallets and price volatility.
